title: Verify synchronous rule execution returns 200 OK with complete response contract for valid CA BusinessValidation request

steps.action: POST /api/v1/rulesengine/execute with valid CA BusinessValidation payload.
steps.expected: 200 OK. Body contains execution_id, aggregated_outcome, total_rules_evaluated, total_rules_fired, total_latency_ms, halted_on_block, is_dry_run, executed_at.

title: Verify response is returned in the same HTTP call without polling — total_latency_ms is within p99 budget

steps.action: POST /api/v1/rulesengine/execute and measure total_latency_ms in response.
steps.expected: 200 OK. total_latency_ms < 500. No polling required — response is synchronous.

title: Verify only rules matching requested ExecutionPhase are evaluated — other phase rules are excluded

steps.action: POST /execute with execution_phase=OccurrenceRating. Check that only OccurrenceRating rules are in rule_results.
steps.expected: 200 OK. Rules from other phases are not evaluated. AC-3.1-002.

title: Verify Batch-only rules (allowed_mode=Batch) are skipped on sync execution path — RealTime and Both rules are evaluated

steps.action: POST /execute synchronously. Verify allowed_mode=Batch rules are not in rule_results.
steps.expected: 200 OK. Batch-mode rules excluded. AC-3.1-002.

title: Verify effective_date resolves correct rules — rules with effective_to before effective_date are excluded

steps.action: POST /execute with effective_date beyond some rules' effective_to. Those rules must not fire.
steps.expected: 200 OK. Expired rules are excluded from evaluation.

title: Verify jurisdiction_code scopes rule evaluation — CA-scoped rules do not fire for TX submission

steps.action: POST /execute with jurisdiction_code=TX. CA-scoped rules must not fire.
steps.expected: 200 OK. Jurisdiction filtering applied. CA rules excluded for TX.

title: Verify halt_on_first_block=true stops evaluation after first Block outcome and sets halted_on_block=true

steps.action: POST /execute with halt_on_first_block=true and input that triggers Block.
steps.expected: 200 OK. halted_on_block=true. aggregated_outcome=Block. Only first blocking rule in rule_results. AC-3.1-003.

title: Verify halt_on_first_block=false continues evaluation through all rules even when Block outcome is encountered

steps.action: POST /execute with halt_on_first_block=false and blocking input.
steps.expected: 200 OK. halted_on_block=false. All applicable rules evaluated. AC-3.1-003.

title: Verify halt_on_first_block=true with Decline outcome stops evaluation and reports Decline as aggregated_outcome

steps.action: POST /execute with halt_on_first_block=true and input that triggers Decline rule.
steps.expected: 200 OK. halted_on_block=true. aggregated_outcome=Decline.

title: Verify is_dry_run=true returns full evaluation result without inserting any DB row

steps.action: POST /execute with is_dry_run=true.
steps.expected: 200 OK. is_dry_run=true echoed. Full rule_results returned. No DB row inserted. AC-3.1-004.

title: Verify is_dry_run=false persists execution result row to DB for audit

steps.action: POST /execute with is_dry_run=false.
steps.expected: 200 OK. is_dry_run=false echoed. Execution record persisted. execution_id can be used for audit lookup.

title: Verify aggregated_outcome reflects worst severity — single Decline overrides all Allow and Warn outcomes

steps.action: POST /execute with input triggering a Decline rule alongside Allow rules.
steps.expected: 200 OK. aggregated_outcome=Decline. AC-3.1-005 severity: Allow<Warn<Block<Decline.

title: Verify aggregated_outcome=Block when Block is the worst severity and no Decline rule fires

steps.action: POST /execute with input triggering Block but no Decline.
steps.expected: 200 OK. aggregated_outcome=Block.

title: Verify aggregated_outcome=Allow when all fired rules produce Allow outcome

steps.action: POST /execute with valid passing input where all rules return Allow.
steps.expected: 200 OK. aggregated_outcome=Allow.

title: Verify rate limit of 100 requests per minute per tenant returns 429 when exceeded

steps.action: Send >100 POST /execute requests within 60s from same tenant JWT.
steps.expected: 429 Too Many Requests returned by rate limiter named 'rules-api'. AC-3.1-006.

title: Verify SystemId and SystemName from M2M JWT claims are captured in execution audit trail

steps.action: POST /execute with M2M client_credentials JWT containing SystemId and SystemName claims.
steps.expected: 200 OK. Execution audit row captures SystemId and SystemName. AC-3.1-007.

title: Verify TenantId is read from JWT User.Claims only — body tenant_id field is silently ignored

steps.action: POST /execute with a different tenant_id in the request body than the JWT claim.
steps.expected: 200 OK. Engine uses JWT tenant, not body value. AC-3.1-008.

title: Verify tenant isolation — one tenant cannot access or influence another tenant's rule evaluation

steps.action: Execute with Tenant A JWT. Verify Tenant B rules are not evaluated.
steps.expected: 200 OK. Only Tenant A rules evaluated. AC-3.1-008.

title: Verify missing phase field returns 422 Unprocessable Entity with FluentValidation error

steps.action: POST /execute without execution_phase field.
steps.expected: 422 Unprocessable Entity. FluentValidation error on phase field.

title: Verify invalid phase enum value returns 422 Unprocessable Entity

steps.action: POST /execute with execution_phase='INVALID_PHASE_XYZ'.
steps.expected: 422 Unprocessable Entity. IsInEnum(ExecutionPhase) validation fails.

title: Verify missing policy_id returns 422 Unprocessable Entity

steps.action: POST /execute without policy_id field.
steps.expected: 422 Unprocessable Entity. NotEmpty validation on policy_id.

title: Verify missing transaction_id returns 422 Unprocessable Entity

steps.action: POST /execute without transaction_id field.
steps.expected: 422 Unprocessable Entity. NotEmpty validation on transaction_id.

title: Verify missing effective_date returns 422 Unprocessable Entity

steps.action: POST /execute without effective_date field.
steps.expected: 422 Unprocessable Entity. NotEqual(default) validation on effective_date.

title: Verify null input_data returns 422 Unprocessable Entity

steps.action: POST /execute with input_data: null.
steps.expected: 422 Unprocessable Entity. NotNull validation on input_data.

title: Verify jurisdiction_code exceeding 10 characters returns 422 Unprocessable Entity

steps.action: POST /execute with jurisdiction_code='TOOLONGCODE' (11 chars).
steps.expected: 422 Unprocessable Entity. MaxLength(10) validation fails.

title: Verify effective_date in DateTime format (with time component) returns 422 parse error

steps.action: POST /execute with effective_date='2026-05-28T00:00:00Z' (DateTime, not DateOnly).
steps.expected: 422 Unprocessable Entity. DateOnly parse fails on DateTime string.

title: Verify missing Authorization header returns 401 Unauthorized

steps.action: POST /execute without Authorization header.
steps.expected: 401 Unauthorized. JWT middleware rejects unauthenticated call.

title: Verify token with rule.readonly policy returns 403 Forbidden — rule.execute is required

steps.action: POST /execute with JWT containing rule.readonly but not rule.execute policy.
steps.expected: 403 Forbidden. Policy gate rejects insufficient scope.

title: Verify GET /api/v1/rulesengine/integration/health returns 200 OK without any authentication token

steps.action: GET /api/v1/rulesengine/integration/health without Authorization header.
steps.expected: 200 OK. AllowAnonymous — no token required. Liveness check.

title: Verify GET /api/v1/rulesengine/integration/info returns 200 OK without any authentication token

steps.action: GET /api/v1/rulesengine/integration/info without Authorization header.
steps.expected: 200 OK. AllowAnonymous — integration metadata accessible without auth.

title: Verify GET /api/v1/rulesengine/info returns tenant-scoped active rule count with valid rule.readonly token

steps.action: GET /api/v1/rulesengine/info with rule.readonly JWT.
steps.expected: 200 OK. Body contains active_rule_count scoped to authenticated tenant.

title: Verify GET /api/v1/rulesengine/info returns 401 Unauthorized when no token is provided

steps.action: GET /api/v1/rulesengine/info without Authorization header.
steps.expected: 401 Unauthorized. JWT middleware rejects unauthenticated request to protected endpoint.

title: Verify empty request body returns 400 Bad Request — all required fields absent triggers validation error

steps.action: Send POST /api/v1/rulesengine/execute with Content-Type: application/json and empty body {}.
steps.expected: 400 Bad Request or 422 Unprocessable Entity. Error body identifies missing required fields.

steps.action: Inspect response body for validation error details.
steps.expected: No execution_id returned. Error message references required fields (policy_id, transaction_id, execution_phase, effective_date, input_data).

title: Verify missing tenant_id field in request body returns 400 or 422 Unprocessable Entity

steps.action: Build a valid execute payload with all required fields, then remove tenant_id. Send POST /api/v1/rulesengine/execute.
steps.expected: 400 Bad Request or 422 Unprocessable Entity. Error references tenant_id as missing.

steps.action: Confirm no execution_id is returned.
steps.expected: No rule evaluation occurs. No execution_id in response.

title: Verify invalid tenant_id value ('abc') returns 400 Bad Request — UUID format validation fails

steps.action: Build a valid execute payload. Set tenant_id to string 'abc'. Send POST /api/v1/rulesengine/execute.
steps.expected: 400 Bad Request. Model binding fails — 'abc' is not a valid UUID (Guid).

steps.action: Inspect error response body.
steps.expected: Error references tenant_id field and UUID format requirement. No execution_id returned.

title: Verify invalid transaction_id value ('abc') returns 400 Bad Request — UUID format validation fails

steps.action: Build a valid execute payload. Set transaction_id to string 'abc'. Send POST /api/v1/rulesengine/execute.
steps.expected: 400 Bad Request. Model binding fails — 'abc' is not a valid UUID (Guid).

steps.action: Inspect error response body.
steps.expected: Error references transaction_id field. No execution_id returned.

title: Verify string value 'false' for boolean field is_dry_run returns 400 Bad Request — type mismatch

steps.action: Build a valid execute payload. Set is_dry_run to string 'false' instead of boolean false. Send POST /api/v1/rulesengine/execute.
steps.expected: 400 Bad Request. ASP.NET Core model binding rejects string type for a boolean field.

steps.action: Confirm no execution_id returned and no rule evaluation occurs.
steps.expected: Error response references is_dry_run field type mismatch. No execution result produced.

title: Verify extra unknown root-level field (transaction_type: 'Quote') is silently ignored or returns 400 Bad Request

steps.action: Build a fully valid execute payload. Add extra field transaction_type: 'Quote' at root level. Send POST /api/v1/rulesengine/execute.
steps.expected: 200 OK (extra field silently ignored — lenient deserialization) OR 400 Bad Request (strict deserialization enabled).

steps.action: If 200 OK: verify execution_id present and extra field not echoed. If 400: verify error references unknown property.
steps.expected: Behavior is consistent. Document whether API is lenient or strict. Extra field has no effect on rule evaluation result.
